title: Concept: cookie without the Secure attribute
description: A Set-Cookie value carries no Secure attribute, so the browser may also attach the cookie to http requests and a single plaintext request anywhere on the site exposes it to an on-path observer. The attribute binds the cookie to TLS and is decided per cookie, not per site.
applicability: Any response whose Set-Cookie values are inspected.
risk: Session or preference cookie readable on the wire; LOW severity alone, higher when the cookie is a session credential.
